title: Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly. New wmnst_catalog.json (10 courses). Real data artifact: the bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan cites 'WMNST 83S', which could not be confirmed to exist (only WMNST 83N is in the current catalog) -- used WMNST 83N. Several downstream prereq strings in the department's own PDF contain typos ('WMST 106', 'WMNST005', 'WMNST001') -- normalized to their evident intent (WMNST 100/106N, WMNST 301N) rather than transcribed literally. WMNST 492W's real prereq needs WMNST 400N specifically, but the plan's own Semester 5 item is a pool of 'WMNST 400N or 401' -- modeled 492W's prereq to accept either, since the plan itself treats them as interchangeable alternatives. 'WMNST course' (7 occurrences) is modeled as a generic slot, matching the bulletin's own open-selection phrasing. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit throughout recent Liberal Arts builds) replaced with a generic slot. Semester 1's own itemized courses summed 4cr short of the bulletin's stated 17.5cr total (a recurring minor source-summarization gap this session) -- not force-corrected. Re-verified against the bulletin's own program-requirements PDF (womens-gender-sexuality-studies-ba_programrequirementstext.pdf): the real 'Select one of' pool for the intro course is WMNST 83N/100/105N/106N (4 real options) -- this plan's Semester 1 item was missing WMNST 105N (which does exist in wmnst_catalog.json), fixed. All other prescribed courses (WMNST 301N, 492W), the 400N/401 pool, the 494/495/496 pool, and the 21cr generic 'WMNST Course' pool count (7 occurrences, matching the bulletin's 15cr Supporting + 6cr 100-200-level buckets exactly) were confirmed correct against the real PDF text. No PSU Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies department handbook (beyond the bulletin) could be found published anywhere -- bulletin-only major.
